import json
from qb.lis import lis

CASES = [[[[]], 0], [[[3]], 1], [[[10, 20, 11, 32, 22, 48, 43]], 4], [[[4, 2, 1]], 1], [[[5, 1, 3, 4, 7]], 4]]


def check():
    for input_data, expected in CASES:
        got = lis(*input_data)
        assert json.loads(json.dumps(got, default=list)) == expected, "lis(%r) returned %r, expected %r" % (input_data, got, expected)
